UPTIME HERALD 1.0.0 IS NOW AVAILABLE

The first public release of Uptime Herald is now available.

https://uptimeherald.org/

Get started here:

https://uptimeherald.org/docs/quick-start/

Uptime Herald is a self-hosted uptime monitoring tool. Point it at what matters to you, and you'll find out the moment it confirms a monitor has gone down. No user accounts. No monthly fees. Deploy via Docker - configure in YAML. Open source / AGPL license.

#selfhosted #opensource #homelab #docker #foss #uptimeherald
